scene.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A glass-roofed orbital conservatory promenade at late morning with silver grasses and a clear bright ceiling — She pauses halfway up the steps to remove her detachable collar panel; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; A silent interplanetary ferry observation lounge at a grey orbital dawn — She traces a tiny flood-level line in the misted glass and smiles at the memory; a small bakery workroom with a floury wooden worktable and warm ovens — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — perched on a ledge or edge; a sunny ranch — sitting on the ground; her home kitchen with a counter — holds a book closed against her chest; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; an airport lounge — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing
